title: Photos of Tim Taylor at Bledsoe children's football games

tellings.quote: didn't Isn't there photos of Tim Taylor at like football games of of Chris Bledso's children or something like that?

plain: A guest who goes by the online name UAPGerb asks on Jesse Michels' podcast whether there aren't photos of a man named Tim Taylor at the football games of the children of Chris Bledsoe, a man who has spoken publicly about UFO encounters. He raises it as a question, hinting that Taylor may have been quietly keeping an eye on Bledsoe's family.
